name: Without Within 2
source:
Vinty is attending a calligraphy event over in Melbourne. At last, she will be able to meet Excelia, the world famous calligrapher. Determined to study and mimic her idol's every move, will Vinty end up losing her identity?

[From [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=487659789]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
translation:
Vinty正在墨尔本参加一个书法活动。终于，她将能够见到世界著名书法家埃克塞莉亚了。决心研究和模仿偶像的一举一动的Vinty最终会失去自己的身份吗？

[来自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=487659789]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
